bug_semantics: An untrusted direct or transitive Composer package could put '..' path segments in its bin metadata. Composer joined that entry to the package install directory without enforcing containment, then its normal binary-installation flow followed the resulting outside-package path and chmod'd an existing host file executable (typically mode 0755 under umask 022), exposing permission-restricted data to other local users.
flaw_origin: Commit aa94918d509c2829866532c8e373a19873b60f31 first introduced package binary metadata and LibraryInstaller::installBinaries. It trusted each package-supplied bin path, formed the source as getInstallPath($package).'/'.$bin, created a symlink to that path, and chmod'd the symlink without rejecting '..' or proving that the resolved target remained inside the package. Its immediate parent 456d442f6e6f948b922251f37a91db9ccb8795e7 had no package-binary installation flow, so this is the smallest public first-write rather than a later rename, extraction, or chmod refactor.
ai_marker: absent: the BIC commit object names author and committer Jordi Boggiano <j.boggiano@seld.be> and contains only the subject 'Add binaries support in composer', with no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, bot identity, or other AI trailer
evidence: GitHub's first-party GHSA-gjfg-22fp-rrxx states that a package bin entry containing '..' can escape the package directory and make Composer chmod an existing host file; it lists affected ranges >=1.0,<2.2.29 and >=2.3.0,<2.10.2 and patched versions 2.2.29 and 2.10.2: https://github.com/composer/composer/security/advisories/GHSA-gjfg-22fp-rrxx

The CVE.org CNA record fetched from https://cveawg.mitre.org/api/cve/CVE-2026-59946 has state PUBLISHED and independently identifies the same chmod path-traversal mechanism, affected ranges, fixed versions, and fix commits 502c6c4f699802d9cf464728b3e8a95674f919a0 and c50b1efd13ebd73f6dca19b31424c5a02bf93cc1.

git show aa94918d509c2829866532c8e373a19873b60f31 -- src/Composer/Installer/LibraryInstaller.php shows the first installBinaries implementation: package-controlled $bin is appended to getInstallPath($package), used as a symlink target, and the link is chmod'd 0777 without traversal or containment validation.

git cat-file commit aa94918d509c2829866532c8e373a19873b60f31 shows one parent, 456d442f6e6f948b922251f37a91db9ccb8795e7, author and committer Jordi Boggiano <j.boggiano@seld.be>, and no trailers or AI marker.

Direct parent-tree verification with git show 456d442f6e6f948b922251f37a91db9ccb8795e7:src/Composer/Installer/LibraryInstaller.php finds no getBinaries, installBinaries, bin-dir, chmod, or symlink binary-installation code; the vulnerable mechanism is absent from the immediate parent.

git merge-base --is-ancestor confirms aa94918d509c2829866532c8e373a19873b60f31 is an ancestor of tag 1.0.0 (32df3aa8cdbdaa16df9491b5e672e81c87f94c78), matching the beginning of the advisory's affected range.

Mainline fix 502c6c4f699802d9cf464728b3e8a95674f919a0 rejects '..' path components in bin metadata in ValidatingArrayLoader and revalidates resolved packages before locking/installing; git merge-base confirms it is contained in patched tag 2.10.2 (8d4439f572a97670a9edc039eb3b093cc976b4bc) but not vulnerable tag 2.10.1 (4120703b9bda8795075047b40361d7ec4d2abe49).

The equivalent LTS fix c50b1efd13ebd73f6dca19b31424c5a02bf93cc1 is contained in patched tag 2.2.29 (ccbe57917efe30262ce80463fc4a6182c5ac29ed) and not tag 2.2.28 (5104b27aaa735dcbadc1bd65f5ff1ef3552c543a), closing the second supported release line.
reasoning: The advisory and published CVE establish a real path-traversal permission vulnerability: dependency-controlled bin metadata reaches the normal binary installer, an outside-package target is resolved, and chmod weakens that existing file's permissions. Reverse file history and the introducing diff place the atomic first-write at aa94918d509c2829866532c8e373a19873b60f31, not the 2016 extraction/rename or the 2021 refactor that changed which path was chmod'd. The immediate parent lacks both bin metadata handling and the installation sink, while tag ancestry places the BIC before 1.0.0. The mainline and LTS fixes reject traversal and occur exactly at the two patched tag boundaries. Finally, attribution is evaluated only on the BIC commit object: its human author/committer and message contain no AI marker, so the real vulnerability is NOT_AI regardless of unrelated later AI-marked repository commits.
